content.title: Victoria Police Raid Fails to Locate Melbourne Cup Trophies
content.caption: Police raid on Melbourne Cup trophies stolen from Flemington racecourse.

slides.heading: Victoria Police Raid Fails to Locate Melbourne Cup Trophies
slides.text: Police raid on Melbourne Cup trophies stolen from Flemington racecourse.

slides.heading: What Happened?
slides.text: A 36-year-old Malvern East man was arrested at the Solomon Street home after thieves smashed their way into a glass display case at the racecourse about 6.30am.

slides.heading: Why Does It Matter?
slides.text: The Victoria Racing Club is devastated by the theft, which is devastating and is in direct contact with Tony Santic, the former owner of the champion racehorse.
